title: Cargo Test
description: Compile Cargo test binaries, then run the staged copies in parallel with per-binary timeouts.

phase.description: compile: cargo test --no-run and stage binaries. run: execute the staged copies without taking Cargo's target lock.

cwd.description: Cargo workspace directory. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

timeoutMs.description: Per-binary wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. A timed-out binary is killed; other binaries keep running.

killAfterMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after SIGTERM before SIGKILL of one test binary's process group.

jobs.description: Maximum test binaries to run at once. Defaults to available parallelism.
